Outside the Ropes trilogy

Boxing romance & romantic suspense.

Outside the Ropes is a dark romantic suspense trilogy about a fighter who learned to survive long before she learned to box. Read the three books in order, or binge the complete series as one box set of 1,162 pages.

Regan Sommers spent her life fighting: foster parents, kids in the group home, classmates. Now she fights for money in the ring, and from the first punch she is addicted. Every addiction has a price, and this one is the gym's star boxer, Gage Lawson, a tattooed package with demands that are more than she can handle.

Good to know

Questions

What order do I read Outside the Ropes in?

Outside the Ropes (Book 1), Inside Danger (Book 2), then OtherSide of Fear (Book 3). The complete series is also sold as one box set.

Are there content warnings?

Yes. The books contain mature content including drugs, sex, abuse, and explicit language that may be upsetting for some readers.

Are the audiobooks available?

Yes. The trilogy audiobooks are narrated by Rebecca Estrella and published by Tantor Audio.

Is it free with Kindle Unlimited?

The ebooks are included with Kindle Unlimited. The box set and paperbacks are sold separately.
